# Quadra Resume Builder

## About
Quadra Resume Builder operates as an online platform focused on helping individuals craft professional resumes and cover letters without unnecessary complexity. The service targets job seekers who need quick access to templates and formatting options that align with current hiring standards. Users can input their details and generate documents that look clean across different industries and experience levels. The platform emphasizes ease of use so people without design skills can still produce strong application materials.

**Areas of Work:** HR, Jobs & Workforce, Software & Internet, Resume Software, Career Tools, Document Creation

## Things to Remember
- **Website:** https://quadraresumebuilder.in
- **Address:** Mumbai, India
- **Contact:** support@quadraresumebuilder.in
- **Phone:** Not Available
- **Hours:** 24/7
- **Timezone:** Asia/Kolkata
- **Currency:** INR
- **Company Type:** Private
- **Employees:** 12
- **Revenue:** Not Disclosed
- **Hiring Status:** Not currently hiring

## Products
- **Resume Builder** (Free tier available, Premium from $4.99/month): Online tool to create professional resumes with templates and ATS-friendly formatting
- **Cover Letter Generator** (Included in Premium plan): Tool for generating customized cover letters matching resume content
- **Resume Export Pack** (Contact for pricing): Export options to PDF, DOCX and other formats compatible with applicant tracking systems

## Services
- **Resume Review Consultation** ($29 per review): Expert feedback on resume content and structure

## Keywords
resume builder, online resume maker, free resume templates, professional resume, cover letter generator, ATS resume, job application tools, resume writing india, career tools, document creation, resume pdf export, entry level resume, mid career resume
